summary: Iteration 161: Tested Self Journey milestone awards, monthly check-ins (checkInDays=0), certificate, PDF privacy/keep-together, Calm Mode and regressions on mobile 390x844 (plus a quick desktop look at the check-in dialog). Backend: 31/31 passed (test_self_journey 13 + test_iter160 public 6 + new test_iter161_awards_checkins 12). Frontend: every requested flow passed. Self-Reflection award shows once with the logo (/images/award-logo.webp, naturalWidth 720). It waits while the SA overlay is open and does not come back after Keep going + reload. The check-in card shows on situation/self-assessment/foundation, not on safety, and 'Not now' hides it. Save check-in shows a toast, the card hides, and checkIns persist with text + planFits. Retake saves the check-in, then opens SA in assess mode with sa-last-time-hint and sa-option-1-last (dashed border) matching the previous answer. ci-plan-no shows 'Update where I am', which saves and lands on /self-journey/situation. sj-checkin-now works on Summary. Co-Parenting Insight award appears on returning to the guide after a completed cp_assessment. Foundation award appears on approve. Save My Journey gives the Journey award and the certificate download (SA_CoParents_Self_Journey_Certificate.pdf, 200 application/pdf, logo image, first name, awards, date). sj-certificate shows on Summary after reload and the award does not repeat. Certificate returns 409 for a parent who has not finished and 401 without auth. Calm Mode: animationName none, 0 canvases (confetti canvas present when calm is off). Journey PDF has no check-in text, and section 7 moved whole to page 2 (no orphaned heading). No horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390) with card/dialog/award. Footer is white down to the strip with no gap (the point just above the strip is .sj-footer), and sj-next is fully visible above the strip. Regressions OK: back link goes to /journey, Safety gate is disabled until a pick, the concern path has no 'Working together', and the Journey Guide reply on concern says 'You shared that you have safety concerns...' (never says the parent is safe).

ui_bugs.issue: The award pop-up (with confetti) can show on the Safety page (/self-journey/safety, index 0), even before the parent has made a safety pick. Reproduced: complete the Self-Assessment via API, then open /self-journey/safety, and the Self-Reflection Award opens over the safety question. Check-ins are kept off the safety page, but awards are not. This is not trauma-informed. Fix: add `index === 0` to the paused expression (line ~243) so the award waits until the parent leaves Safety.

issues: 'Awards earned' lists only Self-Reflection, Co-Parenting Insight and Foundation. The Self Journey Award itself is not listed. Probably fine since the certificate is that award, but confirm with the founder.

action_items: Pause milestone award pop-ups on the Safety step (index 0)
Set checkInDays back to 30 in SelfJourneyPage.jsx (currently checkInDays={0})
critical_code_review_comments: SelfJourney.jsx is 1035 lines (>700). Split the page components (SafetyPage, SummaryPage, FoundationPage, chat sheet) into their own files.
With checkInDays=0 the card comes back on every reload right after saving, because isCheckInDue uses >= 0. This is expected only for the temporary setting.

PUT /self-journey/me replaces the whole doc: a client that sends no checkIns wipes them (awards are protected server-side, checkIns are not). That is OK while the only client always sends the full progress, but consider keeping checkIns server-side the same way awards are kept, if older clients exist.
The award save in useMilestoneAwards swallows errors (catch(() => {})). If the save fails, the pop-up will show again on the next visit. This is acceptable.
